title: I Didn't Know These Photos of Me Existed
description:
You can audit your own online photo footprint with reverse image search and Google's free Results About You tool, then request removal of anything you don't want out there. The safe, self-only way to see where your face and info show up, and how to get it taken down.

#Shorts #privacy #AI

Get the footprint cleanup steps + takedown templates here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1koDRYVCbkdHbZwkQKrj47ApnVRfj-9TgYVp6TwVE9MA/edit?usp=sharing
